title: Hong Hitech (Beijing) Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Hong Hitech (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese high-tech materials company founded in 2013 and focused on industrialized innovation in aerogel and other advanced materials. The company highlights its self-developed gradient reduced-pressure drying process for low-cost, large-scale aerogel manufacturing and its downstream commercialization of multiple aerogel-derived products.

Company Overview

Hong Hitech publicly presents itself as an aerogel industrialization company that combines process innovation, patent development, and downstream product commercialization. Its site lists a broad portfolio spanning aerogel bulk materials, particle and powder forms, blankets, boards, fiber mud, coatings, and cold-chain applications.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Primarily mainland China, with an international-facing web presence.
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel bulk materials, derivative thermal-insulation products, superhydrophobic coatings, and advanced energy/material applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel bulk materials, granules, and powders
  • Aerogel insulation blankets and insulation boards
  • Aerogel insulation fiber mud and firestop materials
  • Superhydrophobic coatings and modified cold-chain boxes
  • Public Capacity: Large-scale industrial production is claimed, but a specific annual capacity is not publicly disclosed on the reviewed pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Sites: Corporate base in Beijing, with automated production bases publicly referenced in Henan and Jiangsu, China.
  • International Certifications: Specific international certificates are not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public pages; the company emphasizes patents and industry honors.
  • Official Website: http://honghitech.com/
